items.source: RSocketServiceArgumentResolver for a @DestinationVariable annotated argument.
items.translation: `RSocketServiceArgumentResolver` 用于 `@DestinationVariable` 注解的参数字段。

items.source: RSocketServiceArgumentResolver for @Payload annotated arguments.
items.translation: RSocketServiceArgumentResolver 用于解析带有 @Payload 注解的参数。
用于元数据条目的 RSocketServiceArgumentResolver。

items.source: Container for RSocket request values extracted from an @RSocketExchange-annotated method and argument values passed to it.
items.translation: 用于存储从带有 `@RSocketExchange` 注解的方法中提取的 RSocket 请求值，以及传递给该方法的参数值的容器。
用于构建RSocketRequestValues的 Builder。

items.source: Resolve an argument from an @RSocketExchange-annotated method to one or more RSocket request values.
items.translation: 从带有 `@RSocketExchange` 注解的方法解析参数到一个或多个 RSocket 请求值。

items.source: Factory to create a client proxy from an RSocket service interface with @RSocketExchange methods.
items.translation: 用于从带有 @RSocketExchange 方法的 RSocket 服务接口创建客户端代理的工厂。

items.source: Builder to create an RSocketServiceProxyFactory.
items.translation: 用于创建RSocketServiceProxyFactory的 Builder。

items.source: Annotations to declare an RSocket service contract with request methods along with a proxy factory backed by an RSocketRequester.
items.translation: 用于声明带有请求方法的 RSocket 服务契约的注解，以及由 RSocketRequester 支持的代理工厂。

items.source: Annotations and support classes for handling RSocket streams.
items.translation: 用于处理 RSocket 流的注解和支持类。

items.source: Annotation to declare an RSocket endpoint on an RSocket service interface.
items.translation: 用于在 RSocket 服务接口上声明 RSocket 端点的注解。
